entries.title: A change you make while a task is being read stays
entries.body: Naming or clearing a model or a basis while a queued task is still being read no longer gets written back over. A task waiting for a computer with room also keeps the words that say why after you quit and reopen, and Activity does not repeat that line.
entries.noPicture: The same Details and Activity rows; the difference is that an edit and a restart no longer undo them, which one still of the open app does not show.
